//===== Description: =========================================

		clear;

		case 1:
			close2;
			callshop "RMD_REFINE",1;
			end;
		case 2:
			callfunc "F_RMD_SEARCH";

			mes "Enchant-material price: 20,000 Zeny each.";
			mes "Coverage: 369 unique materials from Common, Perfect, Upgrade, and Reset entries.";
			mes "The list is alphabetical and divided into small shop pages for reliable client display.";
			next;
			break;
		case 5:
			close;
		}
	}
	end;

function	script	F_RMD_SEARCH	{
	mes "[Enchant Material Search]";
	mes "Enter the numeric Item ID.";
	input .@item_id;
	if (.@item_id <= 0) {
		mes "[Enchant Material Search]";
		mes "The Item ID must be greater than zero.";
		next;
		return;
	}
	.@low = 0;
	.@high = $@RMD_EnchantCount - 1;
	.@found = -1;
	while (.@low <= .@high) {
		.@mid = (.@low + .@high) / 2;
		if ($@RMD_ItemId[.@mid] == .@item_id) {
			.@found = .@mid;
			break;
		}
		if ($@RMD_ItemId[.@mid] < .@item_id)
			.@low = .@mid + 1;
		else
			.@high = .@mid - 1;
	}
	mes "[Enchant Material Search]";
	if (.@found < 0) {
		mes "Item ID " + .@item_id + " is not sold by this dealer.";
		next;
		return;
	}
	.@page = $@RMD_ItemPage[.@found];
	mes mesitemlink(.@item_id);
	mes "Price: 20,000 Zeny each.";
	mes "Location: " + $@RMD_PageLabel$[.@page];
	next;
	if (select("Open shop page:Back") == 1) {
		callfunc "F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE", .@page;
		end;
	}
	return;
}

function	script	F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE	{
	.@page = getarg(0, -1);
	close2;
	switch (.@page) {
	case 0:
		callshop "RMD_E01",1;
		end;
	case 1:
		callshop "RMD_E02",1;
		end;
	case 2:
		callshop "RMD_E03",1;
		end;
	case 3:
		callshop "RMD_E04",1;
		end;
	case 4:
		callshop "RMD_E05",1;
		end;
	case 5:
		callshop "RMD_E06",1;
		end;
	case 6:
		callshop "RMD_E07",1;
		end;
	case 7:
		callshop "RMD_E08",1;
		end;
	case 8:
		callshop "RMD_E09",1;
		end;
	case 9:
		callshop "RMD_E10",1;
		end;
	case 10:
		callshop "RMD_E11",1;
		end;
	}
	end;
}

function	script	F_RMD_BROWSE	{
	while (1) {
		clear;
		mes "[Enchant Material Browser]";
		mes "Materials are sorted alphabetically. Choose a page group.";
		next;
		switch(select("Pages 1-4:Pages 5-8:Pages 9-11:Back")) {
		case 1:
			callfunc "F_RMD_BROWSE_GROUP_1";
			break;
		case 2:
			callfunc "F_RMD_BROWSE_GROUP_2";
			break;
		case 3:
			callfunc "F_RMD_BROWSE_GROUP_3";
			break;
		case 4:
			return;
		}
	}
	return;
}

function	script	F_RMD_BROWSE_GROUP_1	{
	mes "[Enchant Material Browser]";
	mes "Choose the shop page to open.";
	next;
	switch(select("Page 1 - 20th Anniversary ... to Broken Shuriken:Page 2 - Brown Muffler to Deep Poison Crystal:Page 3 - Deep Poison Energy to Feather of Birds:Page 4 - Fire Rune to Ice Magic Stone (...:Back")) {
	case 1:
		callfunc "F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE", 0;
		end;
	case 2:
		callfunc "F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE", 1;
		end;
	case 3:
		callfunc "F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE", 2;
		end;
	case 4:
		callfunc "F_RMD_OPEN_PAGE", 3;
		end;
	case 5:
		return;
	}
	return;
}
